patches: reef fn spot name (for the post ceiling)

definitions.alpha: stage-median clean signed crest-relative alpha (deg) on the 2 m stage grid, limiter-pinned stations excluded (bed.derivedAlphaDeg; PEEL_FLOOR_BASIS.alphaMetric)
definitions.onReef: fraction of stage stations whose line sits on the synthetic uplift footprint
definitions.Vp: median |lineVelocityMps| over clean non-gap stage stations (peel-geometry.js, 14.06 m stencil), m/s
definitions.c: median phaseSpeedMps at the line, m/s
definitions.lineBearing_crestBearing: stage medians, degrees from the stage x axis; alpha is their difference
definitions.dzc: median (z_line - z_crest) in stage metres, z_crest = zRef + tan(beta)(x - 24); negative = the line sits seaward of the wedge crest line
definitions.healthy: alpha >= 10 with the authored (+) handedness and onReef >= 0.5 (the floor criterion)
definitions.walker: alpha >= 30 with the authored handedness and onReef >= 0.5
